name: Memory Health Guard
description: Blocks meal/supplement/hydration/medication/recovery-movement reports from being written into workspace/MEMORY.md's Health section instead of the real tracking scripts — that section isn't read by the Dr. Example weekly journal. Fixed 2026-09-13 after it happened twice the same day. 2026-09-18: also blocks the agent from hand-editing the health log files themselves (food/supplement/breakfast/readiness/restrictions/movement/premeal/feeling/notes/hydration/medication logs) via edit, write, apply_patch, or an exec write — Dr. Example's report is rendered from them; the sanctioned route is dr-physician/scripts/log_day.py.
